Shade leaf qualifier, light exposure; canopy, understorey,	LFLIGHT	unknown											unpub.	Leaf light level. Same categories as CRLIGHT, but LFLIGHT refers to the light exposure of a leaf sample, whereas CRLIGHT refers to the top of the individual's crown.
